rows.text: when the top three bits of byte `+3` of `rcx` (`AND 0xE0`) equal `0x60`, returns qword `+0xB8` plus `0x120` plus `edx` (sign-extended) times `0x80`; otherwise returns 0
when byte `+3` of `rcx` `AND 0xE0` equals `0x60`, returns the sign-extended byte `+0xDC` of qword `+0xB8`; otherwise returns 0

switches on byte `+3` of `rcx` shifted right by 5: for 1 it stores `xmm1` to the float `+0x68` of qword `+0xB8` and stores to its byte `+0x5C` 1 when `xmm1` is below 0.0 (else 0); for 3 it stores `xmm1` to that object's floats `+0xC0` and `+0xC8` and the same below-zero flag to its byte `+0xDD`; every path, including other values, then tail-jumps with `rcx` (at `00269E60` + 0x3A for 3, at `00269E60` + 0x5A otherwise)

when byte `+3` of `rcx` `AND 0xE0` equals `0x60`, stores `dl`, `r8b` and `r9b` to bytes `+0x104`, `+0x105` and `+0x106` of qword `+0xB8` and tail-jumps at `0026A370` + 0x25 with `rcx`; otherwise returns without writing

notes: 00269E60: the two tail jumps at +0x3A and +0x5A reach the same target. The below-zero flag is seta after comiss 0.0, xmm1, so an unordered (NaN) xmm1 stores 0.
